class.name: arm3_interface/ArmInterface
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the Lotti3 arm over serial transport.

class.name: flipper3_interface/FlipperInterface
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the Lotti3 flippers over serial transport. The current firmware is command-only and therefore exposes limited state feedback.

class.name: drive3_interface/DriveInterface
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for the Lotti3 tracked drive. Real transport is available when the optional vendor Unitree SDK is enabled at build time.
